archetypes.name: ci-startup-window
archetypes.rationale: Reviews the new CI startup-deadline control flow and no-checks semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the poll_ci startup-deadline path. Verify the rollup-empty probe distinguishes zero checks from pending rows, the deadline is accounted after wait decisions only, and expiry returns a NO_CHECKS status before sleeping. Check that empty_checks_grace behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ship-resume-state
archetypes.rationale: Reviews ship merge-loop state interactions for first waits and post-push resumes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on ship.py monitor parameter selection and LAST_MONITORED_HEAD persistence. Verify initial zero-counter runs get the one-shot startup deadline, post-push head changes still get blocking grace, and NO_CHECKS stalls preserve resume state for both paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
